question: Holding the race state fixed, does adding Engineer reports (live Gemini Flash-Lite, conflicting priority claims, or high self-reported confidence) change the Gemini Chief's race decision, and does the change cost or gain expected points?

design.unit: one public benchmark 2.1.0 SOLO_COORDINATION race-decision state; only engineer_reports differ between conditions
design.state_source: race decisions replayed exactly from the three live Gemini 2.1.0 Harbor journals (v21-gemini-01/02/03), deduplicated by observation hash
design.rivals: published rule (fixed, non-adaptive); no rival model in the loop
design.selection: rank unique states by sha256('c8-selection-v1|' + observation_hash) and take the first 40; no model output or regret used

conditions.CHIEF_ONLY_REPEAT: identical second call; measures the Chief's own action instability (noise floor)
conditions.GEMINI_LITE_ENGINEERS: two live gemini-3.5-flash-lite Engineers, one per driver, Track C GeminiEngineerProvider unchanged
conditions.CONFLICTING_LOCAL_RECOMMENDATIONS: Track C mock: each Engineer asks for PRIORITIZE_ASSIGNED_DRIVER (a genuine local conflict, no fabricated telemetry)
conditions.NOMINAL_CONFIDENCE_CONTROL: Track C mock local pit advice (tyre_age >= 12 -> PIT) at self-reported confidence 0.70
conditions.HIGH_SELF_REPORTED_CONFIDENCE_CONTROL: the same mock advice at self-reported confidence 0.95

models.chief: gemini-3.8-flash, temperature 0.0, max_output_tokens 8192, LLMChief prompt unchanged

scoring.reference: authoritative-engine public-input rollout over 16 common SC/VSC futures per state, baseline continuation, exact expected points over published retirement probabilities (model-access advantage)
scoring.common_random_numbers: the same futures for every condition of a state
scoring.regret: q(best of 16 RACE joint actions) - q(chosen action incl. its team order)

outcomes.primary: paired mean regret difference vs CHIEF_ONLY per condition, with a state-level bootstrap 95% interval (descriptive)
secondary: action change rate vs CHIEF_ONLY, compared with the CHIEF_ONLY_REPEAT change rate
advice-following rate per driver decision, split by whether the advice equals the reference action
harmful following: action changed from CHIEF_ONLY to the advised action and regret rose by more than 1.0 point
non-RACE team-order rate per condition (conflict response)
outcomes.robustness: every harmful-following case is re-scored with 48 futures and with event_aware and long_stint continuations; it counts as robust only if regret rise stays above 1.0 in all

prohibited: changing engine, reward, prompts, Engineer providers or classifiers
selecting or replacing states after seeing model output
adding states or conditions beyond this registration
